name: game-web2d-specialist
description: > Builds 2D browser games with Phaser 4 (primary), PixiJS 8, Kaplay, Excalibur or LittleJS: framework choice, Phaser scenes, Arcade or Matter physics, Tiled/LDtk tilemaps, atlases, pixel-art scaling, Phaser 3 to 4 migration and Playwright checks. Use for "Phaser", "PixiJS", "Kaplay", "2D web game", "tilemap". Not for 3D browser games (use game-threejs-specialist).
